meta.name: CCNL Poste Italiane S.p.A. (personale non dirigente)

family.reason: Poste Italiane, the universal postal service provider.

notes.text: Salary model: split. base_salary = minimo tabellare (Allegato 9, changes each tranche); fixed_allowances = contingenza (per-level, frozen) + indennità di funzione for A1/A2 (months_per_year=12).
Hourly divisor 156 from Art. 65 III: retribuzione base oraria = mensile / 156. Cross-check: 36h/week × 52/12 = 156 h/month (Art. 26 normal workweek = 36h).

Additional months: 14. Art. 67 tredicesima: base = posizione retributiva + contingenza + EDR — funzione excluded. Art. 68 quattordicesima: same explicit enumeration. Both articles confirm funzione not in mensilità aggiuntive.

Seniority: no traditional scatti di anzianità for new hires. Retribuzione individuale di anzianità (D.P.R. 335/1990) is a legacy element for pre-privatization workers only (Art. 25 CCNL). Model: cadence_months=24, maximum_count=0.

A1/A2 levels: paga base and contingenza are identical for staff and produzione; funzione differs (Art. 21 CCNL). Modeled as two-tier allowances: base rate (staff, unconditional) + produzione delta via role="produzione". Pass Employee(roles=frozenset(["produzione"])) to add the differential.

Apprenticeship: Art. 24 CCNL — under_classification, inquadrato al livello immediatamente inferiore per l'intera durata (max 36 mesi). Destinations B, C, D, E. Level A excluded (Quadri e coordinamento/controllo). Level F excluded (lowest, no level below).

SIMPLIFICATION: EDR (elemento distintivo della retribuzione) omitted. Art. 65 I qualifies it as 'ove spettante'; amount not stated in Allegato 9 or CCNL body. Legacy entitlement for pre-privatization workers only.

limitation.remediation: Model the EDR for pre-privatization workers once its amount is sourced.

notes.text: INDENNITA DI FUNZIONE — PRODUZIONE DIFFERENTIAL: Staff rate (A1: 333.33/mo, A2: 187.50/mo) is unconditional. Produzione workers receive an additional delta (A1: +58.34, A2: +45.83) via IND_FUNZIONE_A*_PROD_DELTA with role="produzione". Total produzione: A1=391.67, A2=233.33 (Art. 21 CCNL K700). Callers: pass Employee(roles=frozenset(['produzione'])) for the higher rate.

SIMPLIFICATION: INPS industria rates applied. Poste Italiane employees are enrolled in the Fondo Quiescenza Poste (INPS special fund, Art. 7 L. 335/1995; merged from IPOST 2012). Correct rates differ from standard industria rates. Verify against INPS Fondo Quiescenza Poste documentation. Verified 2026-09-09: INPS website confirms Fondo Quiescenza Poste exists for Poste Italiane SpA but specific aliquote not publicly listed on INPS portal in machine-readable form.

limitation.remediation: Source the Fondo Quiescenza Poste rates and apply them in place of the industria rates.

notes.text: SIMPLIFICATION: industria CIGO (1.70-2.00%) included in employer INPS rate. Poste Italiane is not a manufacturing firm and is not CIGO-subject; actual employer cost is lower. Verify against INPS circ. for the correct Poste INPS classification.
SIMPLIFICATION: Legacy retribuzione individuale di anzianità (D.P.R. 335/1990) and posizioni economiche differenziate (CCNL 1997) not modeled.

limitation.remediation: Let the caller state the retribuzione individuale di anzianità and the posizioni economiche differenziate (e.g. EarnedIncrements or an individual allowance) and record the limitation.

notes.text: ANTICIPO 2024 (Allegato 10, p. 178): the 'anticipo sui futuri miglioramenti economici' (A1 928.18 to F 571.47) for July 2024 to August 2025 is the una tantum ANTICIPO_2024, paid with the September 2024 pay to the permanent workers in service on 23 July 2024; the paga base keeps the pre-renewal amount for that window. The 'competenze contrattuali arretrate' of the same page (vacanza contrattuale of the first half of 2024, A1 397.79 to F 244.92, '1/12 per ogni mese di servizio') are not modelled: the share of a six-month period in twelfths is not settled by the text.

Art. 41 II: 730 days of retention and full fixed pay over 48 months when Poste special eligibility is documented (listed serious illness with current certification, L. 68/99 certified disability, or certified related life-saving therapy). Ordinary and special episodes both count toward the same window. Without eligibility, ordinary 609/502 applies. The Art. 22 XIII fixed-term contract-length limits remain outside this band.

VACANZA CONTRATTUALE 2024 (Allegato 10, p. 178): the 'competenze contrattuali arretrate' for the first half of 2024 (A1 397.79 to F 244.92), paid with the September 2024 pay to the permanent workers in service on 23 July 2024 'nella misura di 1/12 per ogni mese di servizio', are not paid: twelfths of a six-month period leave the full amount unsettled.

limitation.remediation: Pay the arretrate of Allegato 10 once the share of the six months is settled (six twelfths or the whole amount).

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 67 - Tredicesima mensilità (p. 141): "quanti sono i mesi di servizio prestati presso la Società, computando come mese intero la frazione di mese pari o superiore a 15 giorni.". Match: at_least 15.
Notice bands by level and service checked against the PDF by a separate session (delegated search and independent verification): work_rules.notice.

reviews.scope: Annual minimi tabellari of Allegato 9 read from the page image by an independent session of another model without being told the expected value; divisor from art. 65 read by a separate session.
findings: 35 monthly minimums equal one twelfth of the printed annual amount (art. 65 I: monthly base pay is one twelfth of the minimum; 13th and 14th are separate payments, arts. 67-68).

reviews.scope: Art. 41 II special comporto eligibility, rolling 48-month count and full fixed pay, PDF pp. 111–113.
findings: A documented qualifying condition changes the limit and full-pay days to 730; ordinary days still count in the 48-month window.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

location.section: Allegato 10, Anticipo su futuri miglioramenti economici
location.quote: A1 928,18 A2 842,67 B 744,59 C 700,00 D 675,94 E 619,67 F 571,47 Le somme sopraindicate, maturate pro quota per ogni mese di servizio o frazione di esso superiore a 15 giorni per il periodo dal 1 luglio 2024 al 31 agosto 2025, verranno corrisposte a titolo di anticipo sui futuri miglioramenti economici dei minimi contrattuali di cui alla tabella dell' Allegato 9 e saranno corrisposte esclusivamente al personale con contratto a tempo indeterminato in servizio alla data di sottoscrizione del presente CCNL. L'erogazione delle suddette somme avverrà con le competenze del mese di settembre 2024.

provenance.transformation: The anticipo of each level, for the 14 months from July 2024 to August 2025 (a fraction over 15 days counts), paid with the September 2024 pay to the permanent workers in service on 23 July 2024, the day of signature.

Art. 41 I–II (ordinary and special comporto), pp. 111–112
location.quote: ha diritto alla conservazione del posto di lavoro fino al raggiungimento del limite massimo di 730 giorni di calendario; a tali fini si sommano tutte le assenze per malattia che intervengano, ai sensi del presente comma e/o del precedente comma I, nell’arco temporale di 48 mesi precedenti ogni nuovo ultimo episodio morboso [...] Durante il predetto periodo di comporto speciale, al lavoratore verrà garantita la corresponsione dell’intera retribuzione fissa per tutto il periodo di conservazione del posto.

provenance.transformation: Art. 41 I retains 609 days and 502 full-pay days for ordinary episodes from 2025. Art. 41 II extends the rolling 48-month limit to 730 days and full fixed pay for a documented qualifying episode, including ordinary and special days in the same count. The special rule starts on entry of the 2024 agreement. The listed diagnoses, certified L. 68/99 disability and certified related life-saving therapy require an explicit Poste eligibility fact.

location.quote:
I termini di detto preavviso sono stabiliti come segue:
 anni di servizio   mesi di preavviso
 fino a 5    2
 oltre 5 e fino a 10   3
 oltre 10   4
II. In caso di dimissioni i termini di preavviso sono ridotti alla metà.
III. I termini di preavviso decorrono dall’1 o dal 16 di ciascun mese.

provenance.transformation: Bands proposed by a delegated search and checked band by band against the PDF by a separate session. The resignation bands are left out where halving gives a fraction of a month (the engine computes only the indemnity the employer owes on a dismissal); a start day the text does not set is read as the day after the notice; the ratei of the extra months and the TFR treatment are set only where the text states them.
